offence: Driving a motor vehicle on a road without a valid driving licence authorising that class or description
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — first max 3 years is '3 years or upwards'; also qualified RTA s.127 for driver). Overrides under-3-years default
bailText: Not bailable (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both. Court may order forfeiture of vehicle for repeat (s.35(4)). Mandatory disqualification under s.42 unless special reasons
note: Restored from history after accidental deletion; re-verify on SSO.

offence: Employing or permitting another person to drive a motor vehicle on a road unless that person holds a valid driving licence for the class
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat). Qualified s.127 applies to person in charge
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both
note: Restored from history after accidental deletion; re-verify on SSO.

offence: Driving a motor vehicle on a road while disqualified from holding or obtaining a driving licence (or limited to class)
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat). Qualified s.127 for driver
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both. Mandatory disqualification under s.42
note: Restored from history after accidental deletion; re-verify on SSO.

offence: Exceeding the speed limit (drives a motor vehicle on a road at a speed exceeding the applicable speed limit)
arrestText: No section-specific arrest clause. RTA s.127 is a qualified power for the driver of a motor vehicle. CPC term default: non-arrestable (max imprisonment 3 months first / 6 months subsequent)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both (first offence); second or subsequent: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both. Confirm exact wording and any composition rules on SSO s.63. Demerit points and composition sums enhanced from 1 Jan 2026

offence: Reckless or dangerous driving causing death
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.64(13) — any police officer; also CPC default as max imprisonment exceeds 3 years)
bailText: Not bailable (CPC default — max 8 years first / 15 years repeat)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 8 years; repeat offender: imprisonment not less than 2 years and not more than 15 years. Additional imprisonment if serious / serious-repeat offender

offence: Reckless or dangerous driving (grievous-hurt tier under s.64(3))
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.64(13) — any police officer; also CPC default as max imprisonment exceeds 3 years)
bailText: Not bailable (CPC default — max 5 years first / 10 years repeat)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 5 years; repeat offender: imprisonment not less than 1 year and not more than 10 years. Additional imprisonment if serious / serious-repeat offender. Confirm exact hurt threshold on SSO s.64(3)

offence: Reckless or dangerous driving (no death/hurt variant — contravention of s.64(1))
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.64(13) — any police officer; overrides CPC term defaults). Hurt/death variants under s.64(2)–(4) are separate items
bailText: Bailable (CPC default — max 12 months first / 2 years repeat, under 3 years)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both. Additional tiers if serious / serious-repeat offender (drink/drug related)

arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.65(12); also CPC default as max imprisonment can exceed 3 years)
bailText: Not bailable (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both. Further serious-offender additions — confirm remaining subsections on SSO

arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.65(12); overrides CPC term defaults)
bailText: Bailable (CPC default — max 2 years first / 4 years repeat, under or at 3 years boundary — confirm)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both (first); repeat higher. Confirm exact on SSO s.65(7) or equivalent after 2025 amendments

arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.65(12); overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,500 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both (first); confirm exact tier on SSO

offence: Driving without due care and attention or reasonable consideration (no death/hurt variant — contravention of s.65(1))
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (RTA s.65(12) — any police officer who has committed or is committing an offence under this section; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailText: Bailable (CPC default — max 6 months first / 12 months repeat, under 3 years)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,500 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both. Additional tiers if serious / serious-repeat offender

offence: Use of mobile communication device while driving (holds in hand and operates a function while vehicle in motion)
arrestText: No general RTA express arrest for s.65B. RTA s.127 is a qualified power (police in uniform; driver/person in charge; usually not exercised if licence produced or name/address given). CPC term default: non-arrestable (max 6 months first / 12 months repeat)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both

offence: Driving while under influence of drink, a drug, a psychoactive substance or an intoxicating substance, or with alcohol exceeding the prescribed limit
arrestText: May arrest without warrant any person committing an offence under this section (RTA s.67(3) — overrides CPC term defaults)
bailText: Bailable (CPC default — max 12 months first / 2 years subsequent, under 3 years)
punishment: Fine $2,000–$10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both; second or subsequent: fine $5,000–$20,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 2 years. Mandatory disqualification (first 2 years / repeat 5 years) unless special reasons; life DQ after 2 or more earlier s.67/68 convictions unless shorter period ordered

offence: Being in charge of a motor vehicle on a road or public place (but not driving) while unfit through drink/drug/psychoactive/intoxicating substance or over the prescribed limit
arrestText: No section-specific arrest clause found. RTA s.127 is a qualified power for a person in charge of a motor vehicle suspected of an offence under this Act. CPC term default: non-arrestable (max 3 months first / 6 months subsequent)
punishment: Fine $500–$2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months; second or subsequent: fine $1,000–$5,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 6 months

offence: Failure to provide specimen of breath or blood for analysis (when required under the Act)
arrestText: May arrest without warrant if the person has committed or is committing an offence under this section (check Act-specific; otherwise qualified s.127). Overrides CPC where express
bailText: Bailable (CPC default — typically max under 3 years)
punishment: Confirm exact penalty on SSO s.70 (often aligned with drink-driving scales or specific). Open SSO for current text

offence: Duty to stop in case of accident (fail to comply with s.84)
arrestText: No section-specific arrest clause found. RTA s.127 is a qualified power for the driver of a motor vehicle. Where s.84(8) applies (fail s.84(3) after causing serious injury or death) max 12 months / 2 years — still under 3 years so CPC default remains non-arrestable
punishment: Offence under s.84(7). If failure to comply with s.84(3) and the driving caused serious injury or death: fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both. Other s.84 failures — confirm general penalty s.131 on SSO

offence: Taking and driving away a motor vehicle without consent of owner or other lawful authority
arrestText: Check Act. CPC term default if max <3 years: non-arrestable; if higher, arrestable. RTA s.127 qualified power applies
bailText: Depends on max term — confirm on SSO
punishment: Confirm penalty on SSO s.116. Commonly fine and/or imprisonment

offence: Power of arrest (not itself an offence) — police officer in uniform may stop/arrest in stated cases
arrestText: s.127(1): may stop and arrest a person (not being the driver of a motor vehicle) who within the officer's view commits an offence under this Act, unless name and residence in Singapore are given and the person does not intend to abscond. s.127(6): may arrest without warrant a person in charge of or driving a motor vehicle who has committed or is suspected of having committed an offence under this Act, subject to s.127(7) (licence produced, or name and Singapore address given for non-paid / non-hire / non-goods drivers)
bailText: Depends on the underlying RTA offence
punishment: Not an offence section — enforcement power only
